artists.source_line: A unique trip to beautiful Angola with accommodation and half board provided, organized by Jacinto Teca Events.

features.quote: with accommodation and half board provided
features.rationale: The trip description states that accommodation is provided as part of the package.

features.quote: half board (breakfast, one warm food -lunch or dinner plus non alcoholic drinks during meals)
features.rationale: The package includes half board meals, with breakfast and a warm meal.
The package includes airport pick-up and drop-off transfers.
Dance workshops are listed as part of the trip program.
Local concerts are listed among the trip's experiences.
